note: Livingston County's countywide generalized zoning is drawn in the county's public web viewer from a service at utility.arcgis.com/usrsvcs/.../Planning/County_Zoning/MapServer. That service returns 403 'You do not have permissions' to both direct and spec queries. Municipal zoning (Brighton, Howell, Hartland, Genoa, etc.) is only published as PDF maps or ordinances; no queryable municipal zoning layer found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches.
